annotations.title: Block/unblock a URL from Bing search results

description: AddBlockedUrl + RemoveBlockedUrl: tell Bing to stop, or resume, showing one URL in search results for a project's matched site. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION. There is no verified GetBlockedUrls to list current blocks with — add/remove-only. Bring-your-own-key: requires BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_site' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account.

action.description: add: block this URL from search results. remove: undo a previous block.

date.description: ISO-8601 date for the block. Defaults to now.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

requestType.description: 0 = CacheOnly (keep out of the cache, still crawlable), 1 = full block.

name: update_bing_blocked_url
